dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow, you're practically surrounded by jack frosts!

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: Heh, these little fellas... Back when I used to sweep snow off the streets, I'd always find a few that had gotten themselves trapped. I'd help them out, so they started following me everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Rodion
dialogues.text: Now that I'm retired and not out clearing the streets anymore, they come to keep me company and float all around my stall instead.
